[[File:Jeassa_River_map.jpg|thumb|300px|Map of the Jeassa River]]
The '''Jeassa River''' was a [[river]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. A curved portion of the river was known as [[Kyuu's Twist]]. One of the legs of the [[Nashal River Race]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] circuit led along a part of this river.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
